question: Does a previously unavailable draft.txt remain unavailable after a sealed live-model session changes mirror layers, until an explicit mirror write creates it?
stopping_rule: Run all five launches once; retain failures, timeouts, deviations and incomplete runs without replacement.
preflight: Inside UTM Linux, require scripts/check_kernel.py to emit mirror-kernel-ready before the first model call; each guest worker also requires kernel availability and RealGovernor(harden=True).
freshness: Fresh model conversation and observer registration per launch; one disposable UTM boot for the batch, without a per-launch snapshot reset.
primary_eligibility: The model reads draft.txt before writing, triggers at least one world_transition, then reads draft.txt again before writing.
primary_success: For eligible launches, every pre-write draft.txt read reports resource unavailable, including the read after world_transition.
secondary_checks: A later explicit mirror write may make draft.txt readable in the mirror
limits: Directed task, not blinded recognition study
The model may not follow the requested sequence
Same disposable VM boot across launches
Observer and SSH worker are trusted
